sidebar.emptyHint: Paste a Slack thread link with “Add thread”, or send one from the Chrome extension.
sidebar.warning: Has warnings — open the thread to see them

errors.dm_unsupported: Direct-message (DM) threads are not supported — the token cannot read DMs.
errors.no_token: No Slack token. Add a Slack MCP server with SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN in Settings → MCP.
errors.no_token_for_workspace: None of the Slack tokens belongs to this link's workspace.
errors.invalid_auth: The Slack token is invalid or expired. Update it in Settings → MCP.
errors.missing_scope: The Slack token lacks a scope ({detail}). Needs channels:history, groups:history.
errors.channel_not_found: Channel not found — the token belongs to another workspace or has no access to the channel.
errors.not_in_channel: The token's account has not joined this channel.
errors.thread_not_found: Thread not found — the message may have been deleted.
errors.rate_limited: Slack is rate-limiting API calls. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Network error while calling Slack. Check the connection and try again.
errors.translate_failed: Could not translate the thread (the engine did not start or every batch failed). The original is still readable.
errors.legacy_no_url: This old snapshot has no valid thread link, so it cannot be re-fetched from Slack.
errors.invalid_title: The title must be 1 to 200 characters.
errors.post_missing_scope: The Slack token cannot post messages ({detail}). Add the chat:write scope to the Slack app and reinstall the token.
errors.post_network: Network error while posting — the reply may have reached Slack. Refresh the thread to check before sending again.
errors.reply_too_long: The reply is too long (max 8000 characters).
errors.is_archived: The channel is archived, so the reply cannot be posted.
errors.restricted_action: The workspace does not allow this account to post in the channel.
errors.msg_too_long: The message exceeds Slack's length limit.

warnings.files_scope: The token lacks files:read, so files were not downloaded; click a file to open it in Slack.
warnings.files_partial: Some files could not be downloaded; click a file to open it in Slack.
warnings.users_scope: The token lacks users:read, so some user names show as ids.
warnings.channel_name_unavailable: The token lacks channels:read / groups:read, so the channel name is unavailable.
warnings.translate_partial: Some messages could not be translated — showing the original.
warnings.truncated: Thread too long: only the first 1000 messages were fetched.

header.retranslateHint: Translate every message again with the current translation settings; old translations stay until replaced

links.newSessionHint: Open a new session in the thread's project with this thread referenced in the composer
links.needProject: Pick a project for this thread first

add.title: Add Slack thread
add.urlHint: In Slack: right-click a message → Copy link.
add.noToken: No Slack token (an MCP server with SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN). You can still add the thread, but its content cannot be fetched yet.

legacy.banner: Old snapshot — not re-fetched from Slack yet.

confirm.deleteMessage: Delete this thread with its translated messages and downloaded files?

noSelection: Pick a thread on the left to read it.
empty: This thread has no messages yet.

reply.stale: Source changed — waiting for a new translation
reply.hint: Translated into English when you stop typing · ⌘↵ to send
reply.hintRaw: Sent as-is, no translation · ⌘↵ to send
